mechanism: Phenytoin is a potent CYP3A4 inducer that may increase vedolizumab metabolism, potentially reducing vedolizumab concentrations and efficacy; additionally, both drugs carry immunosuppressive effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor vedolizumab efficacy closely during concurrent use; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available and adjust vedolizumab dosing if loss of efficacy occurs; assess infection risk given combined immunosuppression.
